validatedTree: baseCommit plus the changes identified by sourceFileSha256 (documentation excluded)
scope: Database preparation is admitted with Request(prepare_database): a delegation needs prepare_database and read before a job is stored (CORE-HARDENING structure step 2, item 1)
A delegation never carries administrator authority on list pages: a delegated administrator's grants page shows only its own grants (item 4)
behaviorChanges: POST /api/v1/database/prepare with a read-less delegation: still 403 delegation_scope_denied, but no job is stored (previously the job was stored and later run by the worker)
GET /api/v1/grants with a delegated administrator credential: only that user's own grants (previously every user's direct grants for the delegation's app and environment)
